info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Careers Applications Feedbacks-v4-spec
info.description: The Careers Applications Feedback Retrieval API allows organizations to access feedback associated with job applications. This endpoint helps stakeholders, such as HR professionals and hiring managers, review candidate evaluation comments and assessments to make informed hiring decisions. By retrieving feedback on applications, companies can identify trends, improve their recruitment processes, and enhance candidate experience. Typical use cases include analyzing feedback for performance metrics and refining interview frameworks.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve feedback submitted for applications. It provides a list of feedback entries associated with the applications, helping stakeholders understand user sentiments and improve future iterations.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide feedback regarding applications. It should contain the relevant details and characteristics of the feedback being submitted.

ListCareersApplicationsFeedbacksRequest.description: A representation of the feedback request body in JSON format.

ListCareersApplicationsFeedbacksResponse.title: Feedback Response

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the feedback operation.

state.description: The current state of the feedback process.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the feedback, in milliseconds.

audit.description: Contains auditing information about the feedback operation.

ListCareersApplicationsFeedbacksResponse.description: Schema representing the response structure for the feedback operation.
